# tepian-k3

> A modern, type-safe TypeScript monorepo for K3 safety management, built with Better-T-Stack, Turborepo, and pnpm workspaces.

## Project Overview

tepian-k3 is a full-stack TypeScript application featuring end-to-end type safety from database to UI using tRPC, Drizzle ORM, and Zod validation schemas.

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: React, TanStack Router, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui, PWA
- **Backend**: Hono, tRPC, Node.js, Effect
- **Database**: PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM
- **Monorepo**: Turborepo, pnpm workspaces
- **Type Safety**: TypeScript 5+, Zod
- **Code Quality**: ESLint, Prettier, Husky

## Project Structure

```
tepian-k3/
├── apps/
│   ├── web/          # React frontend with TanStack Router
│   └── server/       # Hono backend with tRPC
├── packages/
│   ├── api/          # tRPC routers & procedures
│   ├── auth/         # Authentication logic & middleware
│   ├── db/           # Drizzle schema & database client
│   ├── queries/      # Reusable database queries
│   ├── schema/       # Zod validation schemas
│   ├── services/     # External services (email, storage, logger)
│   ├── types/        # Shared TypeScript types
│   ├── utils/        # Utility functions
│   ├── constants/    # App-wide constants
│   ├── config/       # Shared configs
│   └── shared/       # Cross-app utilities
```

## Package Namespace

All packages use `@tepian-k3/*` namespace:
- `@tepian-k3/api` - tRPC API definition
- `@tepian-k3/db` - Database schema & client
- `@tepian-k3/auth` - Authentication
- `@tepian-k3/schema` - Zod schemas
- `@tepian-k3/queries` - Database queries
- `@tepian-k3/services` - External services
- `@tepian-k3/types` - TypeScript types
- `@tepian-k3/utils` - Utilities
- `@tepian-k3/constants` - Constants

## Type Safety Flow

Database Schema (Drizzle) → Zod Schemas → tRPC Routers → Frontend Client

## Dependency Order

constants → types → schema → db → queries → services → api → apps

## Key Commands

- `pnpm dev` - Start development servers
- `pnpm build` - Build all packages
- `pnpm check-types` - Type check monorepo
- `pnpm lint` - Lint all packages
- `pnpm db:push` - Push schema to database
- `pnpm db:migrate` - Run migrations
- `pnpm db:studio` - Open Drizzle Studio

## Environment Variables

Required:
- `DATABASE_URL` - PostgreSQL connection string
- `PORT` - Server port (default: 3000)
- `NODE_ENV` - Environment (development/production)
- `JWT_SECRET` - Authentication secret

Optional:
- `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USER`, `SMTP_PASS` - Email service
- `STORAGE_PATH` - File upload path
- `LOG_LEVEL` - Logging level

## Development URLs

- Web App: http://localhost:3001
- API Server: http://localhost:3000

## Code Conventions

- Use TypeScript strict mode
- Define types in `@tepian-k3/types`
- Validate inputs with Zod schemas from `@tepian-k3/schema`
- Database queries go in `@tepian-k3/queries`
- API routes defined as tRPC procedures in `@tepian-k3/api`
- Frontend uses tRPC client for type-safe API calls
